title: timeline.place_clip
description: Place footage on a track at sequence time 'in', starting from 'media_in'. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.4 timeline.place_clip: there is deliberately no 'out' parameter - the clip runs to the end of the footage and is shortened afterwards with timeline.trim_clip (the legacy 'out', 'track_kind', 'track_index', 'with_audio' and 'name' extras are not part of the frozen face).

sequence.description: Opaque entity id (OPP/1 section 5 EntityId): footage / sequence / track / clip / node id. Never parse its format; ids are invalidated on project reload. Defaults to the active sequence.

track.description: Target track id (OPP/1 section 8.4); read ids from project.get_overview or timeline.add_track.

in.description: Clip start on the sequence timeline (rational seconds or frame index).

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.

media_in.description: In-point inside the source media; defaults to 0. Frame indexes are quantized to the footage frame rate.

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.
